scope: System composition of current A0-A8, common README, eight semantic object interfaces and ten open requirements before new individual code-block design. Independent manual premise/edge/counterexample audit with source-hash and JSON checks; no implementation audit or premise qualification.

findings.reason: Source, nonreused epoch/generation, model/calibration/noise/support/coordinates/representation and physical prefix bind stateful evidence and authority. A4 separately retains original prior identity. Semantic dependencies, not pointers or unchecked digests, govern reuse. Interfaces specify abstract obligations, not a byte layout. Fault/reboot identity and finite-horizon counter feasibility remain B_FAULT/B_PLATFORM obligations.

Nominal configurable 35 Hz does not replace actual intervals or qualified interval uncertainty. Ordered nonce ownership, interval-input semantics and explicit gaps preserve physical transport. Fixed row-generator grouping permits a disjoint likelihood sum; changed anchors/rates/calibration cannot relabel old evidence. Re-solving does not consume a prefix again, and an original prior or derived posterior is not added again as independent evidence.

Prepared successors have no authority. Complete commit, unchanged/unconsumed rollback and synchronized quarantine cover admitted outcomes. Consumed and published prefixes are distinct. Cache entries and old state remain live through recovery/publication readers. A3 storage reuse and A4 atomic authority are compatible; an actual fault/concurrency model and layout must still discharge the premises.

Local root projection, numerical convergence, normalized-model distribution comparison, valid physical enclosure and query authorization are separate. Nuisance directions remain joint. Authorization needs the query predicate, qualified simultaneous event or deterministic set premise, matching prefix and valid horizon. Timely qualifying publication under the same scenario law is independently required for availability; permanent refusal and bounded solver termination cannot satisfy it. A4 R+T recovery and A8 service compose only under compatible scenarios and clocks.

Continuous physical support differs from computational domains and codebook nodes. A0 retains cross terms without establishing finite compression. Approximate cache reuse requires both inputs in its certified bucket and enters A6 cumulative accounting. Likelihood oscillation, amplified state-map error, local precision and solver defects have different ledgers. Migration/refinement requires retained information, aligned reference/support/coordinates, excluded-mass accounting and resources. Unknown error is never zero.

A7 supplies the qualified joint historical path required by A6 and A5. The revised SOC sum is conditional on its capacity-boundary convention; RC charge/voltage continuity and pole relabeling remain physical choices. Monotone health/envelope guidance supplies no drift rate or probability law. Thermal changes, offsets and uncertain inputs remain explicit/joint. Ten-year budgets include accumulated approximation and counter capacity. Aged-cell reset needs valid public initialization and cannot renew lifetime risk.

A1 value equivalence explicitly excludes timing and therefore does not automatically satisfy A8 timed closed-loop equivalence. A2 controls reuse/effects and A3 controls bytes. A8 includes keys, transaction backup, pending samples, publications, workspace, stack/ISR, linked code/runtime and retry/miss work; complete layout, arrivals/backlog and useful-service premises remain unproved. Overload invokes gap/authority consequences, not free sample deletion. Changed timing or actions requires joint reachable-state or new policy qualification.

All nine current contract hashes match their individual accepted receipts. A0 remains stationary exact-input/reference-temperature/linear-OCV with fixed public weights; A1 remains fixed-ABI/runtime within-observation refinement. Inclusion does not extend their domains. A6 individual review lacked JSON assembly acceptance and read earlier A7. This review checks current interfaces/requirements and revised A7 compatibility: the A7 qualifications of boundary state law and remaining-support narrowness do not alter A6 mathematics, and A7 has its own accepted r2 review.

Exactly ten open requirements cover physical, sensor, aging, error, action, risk, availability, fault, platform and representation closure. Each states its acceptance boundary and evidence type and remains open without invented numerical defaults. Approximate 10 KiB, nominal 16 MHz/35 Hz and ten-year targets plus SOC/Q development objectives are not measured resources or frozen safety tolerances. Contract completeness defines the obligations; it does not discharge them.

composition_argument: Begin with a bound valid object or quarantine, including physical observation/transport semantics and original prior identity.
A2 substitutions preserve values/effects under complete dependencies; A3 preserves all live byte versions. Neither bypasses A4 ownership or synchronization.
A4 commits a consistent successor or preserves/revokes authority. A6 valid bounds and A7 qualified physical evolution are successor-validity premises, not consequences of commit.
A5 derives the requested guarantee only from qualified joint premises. A8 provides valid timely publication and separately useful acquisition/recovery service under compatible scenarios.
Induction preserves common invariants only when every required premise holds. It does not establish open physical, computational, availability or target premises.
counterexample_checks: A cache hit after a changed rate/temperature is excluded unless the full dependency key still matches; A1 alone does not qualify persistent caches.
Rollback after scratch overwrites old evidence violates A3 all-path liveness and A4 complete outcomes.
Successful consumption followed by failed query cannot be replayed as fresh evidence.
A physically valid candidate outside a basis box is not a physically excluded battery; migration/rebuild/constrained strategy or unresolved status is required.
Small repeated GN widths or TV fidelity cannot establish simultaneous physical coverage, and a pseudoinverse cannot erase unresolved query directions.
Stationary A0 coefficient dependencies do not supply unknown aging/capacity/RC boundary transport.
Warm-cache average throughput or nominal clock cannot bound backlog/deadlines; actual service and arrivals are required.
Identical replay values with different publication timing can change control and future data; A8 timed equivalence or joint bounds are required.
SRAM loss cannot make an aged cell new, revive old authority or renew lifetime risk.

validation.review_method: Manual full-set premise/edge audit, inherited scope inspection, D3/D4/D7/K6 foundation reads, accepted packet hash verification and counterexample search.
validation.context_selection: README and PROJECT_STATE read selectively for active architecture/evidence context; no large raw experiments inspected.
validation.artifact_policy: Exclusive creation of this receipt; original specifications, reviews, source and results preserved.

acceptance_limits: Accepts conditional contract composition only, not a deployable architecture, new kernel or continuous-shape representation.

All ten requirements remain open at their stated acceptance boundaries. Corresponding approximate code-block design and implementation acceptance still require closure; no arbitrary defaults are authorized.
No calibrated physical coverage, useful autonomous recovery, aging/lifetime performance, complete 10 KiB fit, target timing, firmware readiness or mainline promotion is established.
No new implementation is authorized by this receipt. Substantive contract/interface revisions require renewed independent review of affected premises and composition.
Exact hashes bind this set; superseded A2/A7 reviews and snapshots remain preserved evidence.
